name: Banff National Park, Canada
description: Glacial turquoise lakes, towering pine forests, and massive Canadian Rocky peaks. An untamed wilderness where elk roam through mountain valleys and alpine tarns reflect snowy summits in silence.
bestTimeToVisit: June to September for hiking and canoe paddling; December to March for snow powder
highlights: Sunrise canoe ride on the emerald waters of Moraine Lake
Backcountry trekking across Sentinel Pass in autumn
Wildlife spotting in the Bow Valley corridor
Natural sulfur thermal pools in the Upper Hot Springs
